words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the ayah by placing the touching verb under denial before any agent is named. With the imperfect verb that follows, the denial reads as a standing access rule, not a one-time refusal, and {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) later turns that total exclusion into a restricted admission. The same surface can also be read with prohibitive force, so the line can lean toward either a report about who reaches the protected object or a command barring contact; the particle {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), unlike the variant {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), is what keeps that command pressure alive. Its opening long vowel gives negation the first audible beat before the contact verb tightens.

No toucher is named before the exception, so the permitted subject arrives only after exclusion has been heard. words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the turn in the clause. It does not start a separate explanation; it takes the total denial opened by {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and carves out the one admitted subject class, {{ar:ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muṭahharūna}}). Because it follows negation, its exception sense and its onlyness work together: grammar explains how the class is saved from the denied field, and restriction explains why that saved class is the only permitted toucher. That negation-plus-exception shape also carries a core-declaration register, here applied not to divinity but to access rights around the guarded object. The particle has no root or case ending of its own, but it governs the logic of the whole proposition, and its recitational join into the definite group makes the bond audible.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muṭahharūna}}) names the positive side of the restriction: the only class admitted after the denial. Its nominative plural form keeps the group subject-like, and the definite article turns a participial quality into an identifiable access class rather than an indefinite description. The passive Form II participle matters: the agents touch only as ones already made pure, so the grammar foregrounds received qualification rather than self-performed cleansing. Variant and family contrasts sharpen the local choice: an active participle would define the group as purifiers, a Form IV passive would lighten the causative profile, Form V and reflexive options would foreground self-purification, and comparative, command, and purifying-medium forms would move the word into different root lanes. Assimilated variants add pressure at the edge between self-purification and made-pure status without replacing the standard passive form. The root range keeps ritual purity, moral purification, ontological fitness, decontamination-like integrity, and authorized fitness in view, with faith and security co-occurrence as background; local syntax still names only purified status as the access condition, not a second requirement. At the boundary from 56:78 to 56:79, the protected object hands off to purified approachers, and the ayah closes on that qualified group; parallels with purified scriptural media (80:14; 98:2) and purified spouses (2:25; 3:15) add a broader elevated-domain resonance. The heavy sound of the emphatic {{ar:ط}} ({{tr:ṭ}}) and doubled {{ar:ه}} ({{tr:h}}) lets the final word carry the weight of the access condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction around يَمَسُّهُ and the passive plural ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tactile contact is admitted only for a class already made clean; purity functions as fitness to cross the touched object's boundary, with practical cleansing remaining one possible realization.

activation_trace.role: Hand-contact supplies the literal boundary crossing and makes restricted handling the baseline mechanism.
Removal of defilement supplies the qualifying state that permits contact.
Cleansing by washing supplies a concrete, though not exclusive, route into the qualifying state.

changed_reading.before: A generic prohibition on touching while unclean.
changed_reading.after: An exclusive access relation: contact with the referent occurs only through agents who have been made fit for its boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The semantic range of يَمَسُّهُ and the ethical branch of ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Touch can be contact that lands an effect, so the exception can mark the people capable of an uncorrupted, consequential encounter rather than merely those whose hands reach a surface.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching its object turns touch into consequential encounter rather than bare adjacency.
Purifying self and action from wrong supplies the receptive condition that keeps the encounter uncorrupted.

changed_reading.before: Only clean people make physical contact.
changed_reading.after: Only those made ethically clean achieve the kind of contact in which the referent truly reaches and changes its receiver.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between the entanglement branch of م س س and the cleansing force of ط ه ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: If touch shades into confused intermixture, purification is what allows approach without conflating or adulterating what is encountered.

activation_trace.role: Entangled mixture supplies the failure mode hidden inside an undisciplined touching.
Clearing away impurity supplies the separation that prevents confused mixture.

changed_reading.after: Purity makes non-confusing apprehension possible: the qualified touch without mixing the encountered thing with foreign matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fixed points of occurrence and emergence lead into gathered recitation, joined writing, protective concealment, and delivered descent. Within that ordered transfer, touch becomes the controlled interface between a guarded register and what is conveyed outward.

activation_trace.role: Literal contact supplies the interface at which custody or transfer can occur.
Freedom from defilement supplies the fitness of those admitted to the guarded interface.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies determinate transfer points rather than diffuse movement.
Emergence into visibility supplies the outward manifestation side of the transfer.
Gathering supplies the integration of what is transmitted into a coherent whole.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the stable register being guarded.
Protective concealment supplies the guarded boundary on which selective touch operates.
Delivery downward supplies the outward movement that requires a trustworthy interface.

structural_cues: 56:77-80 places the focus between an honored recitation in a protected book and its delivery from the Lord of the worlds.
The movement from fixed stellar positions to emergence and then descent gives the passage a controlled spatial sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed occurrence, emergence, gathering, writing, protective concealment, and delivery; I infer a custodial chain and assign touch to its guarded interface. Literal handling without a transfer model remains live.

changed_reading.before: Purified people alone may handle a sacred object.
changed_reading.after: Those made pure are the admissible interface in a protected transmission, touching where concealed registration becomes delivered recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience can coat the discourse with smooth compromise or oppose it with falsehood. Purified touch is therefore a reception that neither smears the encountered message nor blocks its effect.

activation_trace.role: Effect-bearing contact supplies the receptive encounter whose success is being tested.
Purity of self and action supplies resistance to corrupting the encounter.
Oil or coating supplies a material image for overlaying the discourse with foreign matter.
Soft compromise supplies the social mode by which an apparently smooth reception evades the message.
Contradiction of truth supplies the terminal form of failed reception.

structural_cues: 56:81-82 turns immediately from the delivered discourse to the audience's compromising and denying response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coating, conciliatory softness, and falsehood; I infer that these are modes of contaminating contact and that purification names unadulterated reception. The lines may alternatively remain a general rebuke unrelated to the touch image.

changed_reading.before: Purity is a condition possessed before contact.
changed_reading.after: Purity is also visible in the contact itself: the receiver lets the discourse arrive without coating it in compromise or converting provision into denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: At death something reaches the throat while observers look, remain less near than an unseen presence, and cannot return what is departing. The sequence separates visual or bodily proximity from effective access, sharpening touch into operative reach across a hidden boundary.

activation_trace.role: An effect that reaches supplies the focus's stronger sense of operative rather than superficial contact.
Purified fitness supplies the capacity assigned to the exceptional group at the boundary.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the throat as a terminal threshold.
Directed sight supplies perceptual presence that proves insufficient for effective access.
Nearness supplies a proximity deeper than that of the visible observers.
Eyesight supplies the explicitly denied channel, distinguishing seeing from boundary access.
Restoring something to its former state supplies the impossible control test for human contact.

structural_cues: 56:83-87 forms a continuous threshold scene: reaching, watching, unseen nearness, and failed return.
The challenge to return the departing entity tests agency rather than mere spatial closeness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint-reaching, sight, nearness, non-seeing, and attempted return; I infer that touch in 56:79 can denote effective boundary access. The death scene may instead function only as a later analogy and not specify the focus referent.

changed_reading.before: Touch means being physically close enough to make contact.
changed_reading.after: Touch means effective reach at a concealed threshold; ordinary observers may be present and looking yet still lack the access possessed by the purified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later passive class of those brought near mirrors the focus's people made pure. The shared conferred-state pattern makes access look granted through transformation and favor, not claimed through self-certified cleanliness.

activation_trace.role: Contact supplies the privilege whose source of authorization is being reconsidered.

structural_cues: The passive forms ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ in 56:79 and ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ in 56:88 describe classes acted upon rather than self-appointed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purified and brought-near passive classes plus the favored-intimate branch; I infer a common logic of granted fitness and access. The two classes need not be extensionally identical.

changed_reading.before: People gain permission by cleaning themselves.
changed_reading.after: Access belongs to people made fit and brought into privileged proximity; purification is received status before it is a human credential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated descent/reception root moves from delivered revelation to a prepared reception of hot water followed by meeting fire. Because water-contact can belong to punishment, the practical-washing branch cannot by itself exhaust what makes the exceptional group purified.

activation_trace.role: Contact that delivers an effect supplies the common mechanism whose outcome can differ.

Meeting the heat of fire supplies the harmful consequence of the wrong mode of reception.

structural_cues: The root ن ز ل frames both 56:80 and 56:93, but the first arrival is revelation and the second is punitive provision.
56:93-94 couples hot water with direct exposure to fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelatory delivery, prepared reception, hot-water washing, and meeting fire; I infer polar outcomes of encounter and therefore deny that water exposure alone defines focus-purity. The two uses of ن ز ل may remain rhetorically parallel without sharing one reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Practical washing is sufficient to identify the purified touchers.
changed_reading.after: The decisive purity precedes and governs contact: a medium associated with washing can itself become punitive, so bodily washing cannot exhaust the qualification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close identifies fixed truth, certainty without doubt, and the clearing of the Lord's named designation from defect. This gives purified touch an epistemic and verbal form: contact with truth is maintained by removing false attribution.

activation_trace.role: Effect-bearing contact supplies the passage from truth encountered to truth settled in the receiver.

Clearing from defect supplies a verbal purification that answers the focus's ethical purity.
The name as designation supplies the linguistic site on which that clearing is enacted.

structural_cues: 56:95-96 closes the unit by moving from truth and certainty to an imperative of tanzih directed through the Lord's name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed truth, certainty, clearing from defect, and naming; I infer an analogy between tanzih of designation and purification of the receiver. Bodily purity and epistemic purity can still coexist rather than exclude one another.

changed_reading.before: Purified touch is chiefly a bodily access condition.
changed_reading.after: Purified touch culminates as truthful apprehension and undefiling speech: certainty is contacted by a receiver who clears rather than falsifies the named source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates reproductive side branches beneath overtly scriptural surfaces. It remains anchored in the focus through intimate م س س and menstrual or washing ط ه ر, and the nearby womb-gathering, protective enclosure, and seminal descent branches make a coherent material analogy. Render only as an exploratory image of protected generative transmission, never as a translation, legal ruling, or claim that the passage's referent is sexual.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The intimate-contact branch of يَمَسُّهُ beside the menstrual-purity and washing branches of ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ.

activation_trace.role: Intimate contact supplies the generative boundary-crossing image.
Menstrual cessation and purity supply the cyclical bodily qualification around generative contact.
Washing supplies the enacted transition into bodily readiness.
A womb gathering a pregnancy supplies the interior collection and formation stage.
Protective concealment supplies the guarded enclosure around what is forming.
Seminal outflow supplies the form-distant material image of generative transmission or descent.

changed_reading.before: The line restricts handling of a protected text.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the line can image protected generation: prepared intimate contact admits a gathered content into or out of a guarded interior.

strongest_changes: The immediate context revises touch from isolated handling into the controlled interface of a concealed-to-delivered transmission.
The death scene distinguishes effective access from looking or bodily proximity, making touch operative reach across a hidden threshold.
The passive class of those brought near makes the purified class look conferred and admitted rather than self-authorized.
The later hot-water reception weakens any reduction of purification to washing alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two compact roots became a hinge among custody, reception, threshold agency, and conferred proximity; the packet also sustained a clearly contained gestational material analogy that a conservative reading would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The pronoun's precise referent is not settled by the focus line alone.
Physical handling, effective reception, and mediated transmission may coexist, but the trace cannot determine their relative priority.
The reproductive outlier is branch-coherent yet highly form-distant and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Contact is restricted to those made free of defilement.** `م س س` **B001** supplies contact by touch; `ط ه ر` **B001** supplies purity with defilement removed. The passive `المطهرون` parallels the passive `المقربون`: status is received before access. **Abductive move:** I infer that purification enables protected contact. **Reading change:** touching is an admitted relation, not mere physical reach.

2. **Only the purified receive its effect.** `م س س` **B004** supplies being touched by an effect; `ط ه ر` **B005** supplies cleansing conduct from blame. **Abductive move:** I infer a bidirectional contact: they touch the text and its effect touches them. **Reading change:** `يمسه` can describe transformative reception as well as handling.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The unseen nearness of 56:85 made contact here part of a wider packet distinction between physical visibility and effective access.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An exceptive access boundary joins contact to conferred purity.** Negated `م س س` (B001, physical contact by touch) is opened only to `ط ه ر` (B001, purity with defilement removed, including the *muṭahhar* state). Ayat 74–78 command praise and locate noble recitation in a protected book; ayat 80–84 describe descent, evasive reception, falsification, and life reaching the throat while observers look. The packet supplies actual contact, strict exception, and a passive-result purity form; I infer authorized intimacy rather than unrestricted possession. Within this immediate sequence, the boundary first characterizes access to the concealed book, before descent names transmission outward.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:80 immediately announces descent, correcting an unrestricted physical-access reading: the local boundary characterizes contact with the protected register even as its discourse becomes communicable.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli seçeneklerden birinin daha izinli olduğunu bildirir; komşu ise karşılaştırma gerektirmeyen genel bir davranışsal arınmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, izinli ilişkiyi yasak olandan daha temiz sayar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, bir sözün veya eylemin doğru olması ve amacına ulaşması ölçüsünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir seçeneği olumlu ve uygun bulma alanında değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak izin ve yasak karşıtlığına dayalı ilişki seçimini, komşu ise doğruluk ve yanlışlık karşıtlığına dayalı söz veya eylem değerlendirmesini anlatır.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
